# cmd/constitution-lint/doc-waivers.txt
# Waives ALL doc-coverage findings for a package directory. One
# module-relative path per line; # comments and blank lines are ignored.
#
# This file is intentionally empty. doc-coverage's first live run
# (2026-07-16) surfaced 94 missing/malformed doc comments across 23
# packages; every one of those gaps was fixed in the same change-set that
# introduced the check, rather than waived, so this file lists nothing.
# It remains as the escape hatch for any future package that genuinely
# cannot be brought into doc-coverage compliance in the same change that
# extends enforcement to it — add a module-relative directory path per
# line, with a comment above it explaining the gap and why it isn't fixed
# directly, the way the first-run gaps were described here before they
# were closed.
